clue.text: Stumped by simple-minded person's landing

parts.note: ST is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for stumped
an airhead is a foolish, empty-headed person

explanation.surface: A dim-witted person ends up stumped, or a wicketkeeper's victim takes a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: The top landing of a staircase, where the flight ends, is called by this name.

clue.text: Source of illumination in the long run

explanation.surface: A light that keeps burning, whose value shows itself eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the long run' reads as a stock phrase, but 'run' is the anagram signal working on IN THE LONG.
explanation.definitionFit: A tube of glowing gas used in signs is a familiar lamp or lighting source.

clue.text: Bug French painter about old painting's finish

parts.note: Edward Hopper was an American painter

indicators.note: a painting's finish is its final letter

explanation.surface: A critic picks at a French artist's work near the end of an old canvas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts the old-plus-final-letter pair inside the French-plus-painter pair; Edward Hopper is the American painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A froghopper is a small jumping insect, and bug is used loosely for any insect.

clue.text: Supporter of unusual intelligence

indicators.note: of here means made out of, taken from within, the two words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone who backs a person of rare intellect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters sit in order across the end of 'unusual' and the start of 'intelligence'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lintel is the horizontal beam that bears the load above a door or window, so it supports.

clue.text: Celebrity set fair to appear regularly

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the words before it, beginning with the first

explanation.surface: A famous person is expected to turn up at a fete at regular intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity is a famous performer, a household name in show business.

clue.text: One character in Western having a setback — what a pity!

indicators.note: one letter of the film's title is singled out for change
that letter is set back one place in the alphabet, the N becoming the letter before it

parts.note: Shane is a classic 1953 Hollywood western film

explanation.surface: A cowboy hero suffers a reverse, and the narrator sighs over it.
explanation.walkthrough: Setback works alphabetically: N moves back one place to M, turning the film title into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying it is a shame is a stock way of saying it is a pity.

clue.text: Woman Frayn finally cast in Donkeys' Years

indicators.note: cast in means put or thrown into the middle of the other piece

parts.note: donkey's years is an idiom for a very long time

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the playwright's surname

explanation.surface: Michael Frayn chose a woman for a role in his play Donkeys' Years.
explanation.walkthrough: Donkeys' Years is a real Frayn comedy, so 'cast' looks theatrical; here it means put inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnes is a female first name, so it is an example of a woman.

clue.text: One formerly known as Prince's courage is shown in motorcycle races?

indicators.note: shown in places the courage pieces within the races

parts.note: TT is the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy motorcycle races
heart means courage or spirit

explanation.walkthrough: The singer Prince was styled 'The Artist Formerly Known As Prince' in the 1990s; 'Prince's' reads as a royal but the 's is just 'has'.
explanation.definitionFit: The singer used this title during the years he dropped his name for a symbol.

clue.text: Boy to embrace with love

parts.note: to embrace someone is to hug them
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A lad is told to give someone an affectionate cuddle.
explanation.definitionFit: Hugo is a male first name, so it is an example of a boy.

clue.text: Dim thing difficult to find when it's dark

indicators.note: difficult suggests the letters are awkwardly arranged and must be sorted out

explanation.surface: A faint object is hard to spot at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve at night is a time deep in the hours of darkness.

clue.text: Republican with money problems? Not exactly!

definitions.text: Republican with money problems? Not exactly!

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for Republican in US politics

indicators.note: problems implies the letters of the word before are in trouble and jumbled

explanation.surface: A US politician supposedly short of cash, which is ironic.
explanation.walkthrough: Mitt Romney, the 2012 Republican presidential candidate, is famously wealthy, hence 'Not exactly!'.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue describes a rich Republican politician, the very opposite of having cash troubles.

clue.text: In this Meryl's heart's not always in playing of hardline Tory?

definitions.text: In this Meryl's heart's not always in playing of hardline Tory?

indicators.note: playing of means the letters are rearranged, performed in a new order
the middle letter of the actress's name is present only once, not every time, so one copy is removed
the heart of the actress's first name is its middle letter

explanation.surface: Meryl Streep's performance as a hard-line Conservative leader is a qualified success.
explanation.walkthrough: HARDLINE TORY has two Rs; 'not always in' removes one R (the heart of MERYL), then 'playing of' rearranges the rest. Meryl Streep played Margaret Thatcher in the 2011 film.
explanation.definitionFit: The 2011 film starring Meryl Streep portrays Margaret Thatcher, the uncompromising Conservative prime minister.

clue.text: Sweet-scented flower originated around Slovakia, below embankment

parts.note: a dam is an embankment holding back water

parts.note: arose means came into being, originated
SK is the international code for Slovakia

explanation.surface: A fragrant bloom first grew in Slovakia, beneath a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: This old rose variety, pink and highly fragrant, is grown for attar of roses.

clue.text: Hormone replacement treatment of ailment's working internally

explanation.walkthrough: 'Hormone replacement treatment' reads as HRT, but the definition is just 'Hormone'.
explanation.definitionFit: Melatonin is a hormone secreted by the pineal gland that regulates sleep.

clue.text: Reformed sea dog now in perfect condition

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes something restored so well it seems unused.

clue.text: Closed before closing time in drinks fiascos

explanation.walkthrough: 'before closing time' suggests pub hours; it says SHUT without its final T.

clue.text: Traveller in Italian capital going over Beethoven's Piano Concerto in E-flat major

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

clue.text: Senior citizen cooking almond
